name: Hyundai Futurenet Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyundai Futurenet Co., Ltd. engages in the digital signage, immersive content, and corporate messaging businesses in South Korea. The company operates and develops IT resources and systems. It also offers server-network building and operations, and management services; cloud consulting, design, building, operations management, services for cloud, as well as professional, migration, and managed services; customized generative AI services. It also manufactures and sells cosmetic, and pharmaceutical raw materials, as well as involved in research and manufacturing activities. The company was formerly known as HCN Co., Ltd.
